en.joke: My AI assistant just suggested I 'take a break.' It's clearly learning my procrastination habits.
en.explanation: The humor comes from AI unexpectedly mirroring human flaws in a deadpan, relatable way.

people.name: Sarah Ferguson
people.extract: Sarah Margaret Ferguson, formerly Sarah, Duchess of York, and commonly known as Fergie, is a British author, spokesperson, and television personality. She is the ex-wife of Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor, the former Prince Andrew, Duke of York, who is the second son of Queen Elizabeth II and the younger brother of King Charles III.
highlights: British author, spokesperson, and television personality.
Ex-wife of Prince Andrew, Duke of York.

people.name: Mira Nair
people.extract: Mira Nair is an Indian American filmmaker. She has received two prizes from the Cannes Film Festival and four from the Venice Film Festival, as well as nominations for an Academy Award, two BAFTA Awards, a Golden Globe, and two César Awards.
highlights: Received two prizes from Cannes Film Festival.
Received four prizes from Venice Film Festival.

people.name: Linda Lavin
people.extract: Linda Lavin was an American actress and singer. Known for her roles on stage and screen, she received several awards including three Drama Desk Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, two Obie Awards, and a Tony Award, as well as nominations for a Daytime Emmy Award and a Primetime Emmy Award. She was inducted into the American Theater Hall of Fame in 2010.
highlights: Inducted into American Theater Hall of Fame in 2010.
